description: This Java source file defines a final class PersistenceIdSource that provides a method to create an Akka Stream source streaming entity IDs with revisions. It is part of the persistence and entity streaming mechanism in the project, involving pub/sub messaging, source initialization, and error handling.

classes.name: PersistenceIdSource
classes.description: A utility class to create Akka streams that produce snapshot entity IDs with revisions, handling recovery, backoff, and errors.

classes.name: EmptyEntityIdWithRevision
classes.description: A private static class representing an empty or lower-bound placeholder for entity ID revisions in the stream.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a stream of entity ID revisions based on the persistence IDs configuration and pub/sub mediator.

methods.name: buildResumeSource
methods.description: Constructs a Resumable source for entity IDs with revision, using backoff and recovery strategies.

methods.name: checkForErrors
methods.description: Checks the result of pub/sub messages for errors and produces an appropriate source, either normal or failed.

methods.name: requestStreamCommand
methods.description: Creates a pub/sub command to request entity ID stream data.

methods.name: sudoStreamPids
methods.description: Builds a SudoStreamPids message with configuration and seed entity ID.

methods.name: handleSourceRef
methods.description: Resolves SourceRef reply objects into Sources of EntityIdWithRevision.

methods.name: createSourceFromSourceRef
methods.description: Converts a SourceRef into an Akka Source stream.

methods.name: failedSourceDueToUnexpectedMessage
methods.description: Produces a failed Source with an IllegalStateException for unexpected message types.
